versions.changelog:
chuwi-minibook v1.0.1

- Added main Python logic file: chuwi_minibook.py
- Updated and expanded SKILL.md with more detailed function descriptions and B站学习 logs
- Removed skill-card.md

- Initial release of Chuwi Minibook system monitoring tool.
- Provides one-click system info gathering: CPU, memory, disk, battery, temperature, and platform data.
- Supports quick summary and dedicated battery status modes.
- Cross-platform hardware monitoring powered by psutil.
- Requires Python 3.10+ and psutil.
